data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Iasios, meaning 'God heals'. This name appears in the New Testament as the name of two saints: Jasius, a relative of Jesus, and Jasmin, a martyr in Cyprus. In Christian tradition, Jasian is a name that evokes healing, restoration, and God's divine intervention in times of need. The name Jasian carries the meaning “God heals” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Jasian usually hope their child will grow to embody god heals and live with faith, good character and purpose.
